caption: The video captures a nighttime fireworks display over a body of water. A distant lit shoreline, a slender central tower, and left-side searchlight beams persist against a dark sky. In the upper-middle sky, three scattered dot-clusters in pink, red, and blue-violet are already spread out, slowly thinning as their points dim. As these fade, new spherical shells resolve in the center-left sky, expanding into radial bursts—a blue-violet sphere left and a red-orange sphere right. A smaller faint shell blooms farther out, and these later spheres grow and hold their shape, losing density gradually rather than drifting across the frame. The water mirrors the sky throughout, its warm orange streaks joined by violet-blue and red reflection patches that wobble with surface ripples. The display remains mid-process, the expanding spheres still glowing above the mirrored shoreline.
relations: As initial dot clusters dim, new spherical shells emerge and expand into radial bursts in the center-left sky.
New blue-violet and red-orange spheres grow and hold shape, gradually losing density without drifting across the frame.
Water mirrors the changing sky, warm orange streaks joined by wobbling violet-blue and red reflections from ripples.
